title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese on Strengthening Judicial Protection of the Rights and Interests of Overseas Chinese in the New Era
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese

Opinions on Strengthening the Judicial Protection of Overseas Chinese Rights and Interests in the New Era

Fa Fa [2024] No. 18

All high people's courts and federations of returned overseas Chinese of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To implement the guiding principles of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 20th Central Committee, to lawfully and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and their family members as well as the legitimate rights and interests of overseas Chinese compatriots, and to integrally advance the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests and legal services, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

1. Overall Requirements. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on overseas Chinese affairs, adhere to a people-centered approach, continuously enhance the awareness of serving overseas Chinese, and improve the level of service for overseas Chinese. Adjudicate cases involving overseas Chinese fairly and efficiently, promote diversified resolution and source resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese, and actively explore effective paths for strengthening the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests under the new circumstances. Rely on leadership from Party committees, actively seek support from relevant government departments, adhere to the principles of focusing on practical results, applying the rule of law, and leveraging technology for empowerment, and continuously consolidate the talent, system, and institutional foundations for the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, thereby helping to improve the work level.

2. Optimize the Trial Mechanism for Cases Involving Overseas Chinese. The Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, together with relevant departments, shall further clarify the criteria for identifying cases involving overseas Chinese, rely on the nationwide "one network" construction of courts, improve the statistical caliber for cases involving overseas Chinese, and do a solid job in analyzing the trial trends of cases involving overseas Chinese and researching common issues. Higher people's courts, especially the Supreme People's Court and high people's courts, shall strengthen trial supervision and guidance, promptly resolve difficulties and bottlenecks in trials, unify the adjudication standards for cases involving overseas Chinese, and summarize and refine experience and practices for handling cases involving overseas Chinese. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with legal provisions and international treaties concluded or acceded to by China, promote the resolution of practical difficulties such as difficulties in serving documents in cases involving overseas Chinese compatriots and inconvenience in participating in litigation, thereby continuously enhancing the sense of gain of overseas Chinese compatriots regarding judicial service for the people and judicial fairness.

3. Strengthen Litigation Services for Cases Involving Overseas Chinese. People's courts at all levels shall, relying on relevant informatization platforms, provide services such as online filing, payment, mediation, court hearings, judicial confirmation, identity authentication, and authorization for parties in cases involving overseas Chinese, and actively guide such parties to reasonably exercise their right to sue, preventing procedural waste due to parties' lack of knowledge of domestic legal provisions and litigation procedures or inconvenience in participating in litigation. In conjunction with the construction of digital courts, promote the breaking of data barriers, enabling "one-click query" of high-frequency needs such as entry and exit records, real estate certificates, marriage certificates, and notarized certificates within the platform, so as to "let data run more and let parties run less". Adhere to the combination of online and offline, summarize and promote mature experiences such as cross-domain litigation services, shared courts, and specialized courts for overseas Chinese cases, and, in light of the characteristics of cases involving overseas Chinese and the circumstances of the parties, actively coordinate with relevant departments to carry out work such as legal aid and judicial assistance.

4. Deepen the Prevention and Resolution of Disputes Involving Overseas Chinese at the Source and at the Preliminary Stage. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen research and analysis on the number, type, distribution, and changing trends of cases involving overseas Chinese, and, with regard to prominent issues leading to the frequent and high incidence of disputes involving overseas Chinese and affecting economic and social development and the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, shall, as appropriate, submit judicial suggestions to relevant competent authorities or other relevant units for improving work and governance, striving to resolve conflicts and disputes before they arise or while they are still in their infancy. Actively integrate into the social governance work pattern led by Party committees and governments, rely on comprehensive social security governance centers, mediation rooms for disputes involving overseas Chinese, and other means to gather resources and forces from all sides, give play to the functions of conflict and dispute investigation and resolution, trend research and early warning, etc., so that more conflicts and disputes are resolved at the source. Federations of returned overseas Chinese at all levels shall play a good role as a bridge and link, smooth the channels for the expression of interests of the overseas Chinese community, focus on the urgent difficulties and concerns of the overseas Chinese community, integrate such work methods as legal publicity, petitions, and legal services, and continuously enhance the efficiency and advantages of diversified resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese.

5. Improve the Legal Service Mechanism for Matters Involving Overseas Chinese. Federations of returned overseas Chinese at all levels shall adhere to the principle of combining petitions with mediation, with mediation taking precedence, conduct petition work involving overseas Chinese in accordance with laws and regulations, and for matters that cannot be resolved through mediation and fall within the scope of acceptance of the people's courts, advise visiting overseas Chinese compatriots to apply to the people's court with jurisdiction for resolution according to law; promote public legal services, provide legal consultations related to overseas Chinese; keep abreast of domestic and international situations and changes in the overseas Chinese community, and deeply understand the needs for protecting overseas Chinese rights and interests; strengthen communication and contact with judicial administrative organs and bar associations, build a legal service team, give play to the role of legal advisory committees, public lawyers, and legal volunteers, fully mobilize the enthusiasm of lawyers to participate in the resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese, leverage the professional and occupational advantages of lawyers, and at the same time vigorously absorb other professionals to participate in the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, providing professional and effective legal services for returned overseas Chinese, their family members, and overseas Chinese compatriots. Give full play to the role and advantages of overseas Chinese compatriots and overseas legal professionals in ascertaining foreign laws, legal exchanges and cooperation, researching national dispute resolution systems, and training legal talents with international perspectives. People's courts at all levels shall, in conjunction with the trial of cases, put forward opinions and suggestions to promote the strengthening and regulation of legal services related to overseas Chinese.

6. Promote the Formation of a Grand Mediation Work Pattern for Disputes Involving Overseas Chinese. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, organically connect people's mediation, administrative mediation, judicial mediation, and industry-specific professional mediation, and promote the improvement of the diversified dispute resolution linkage and connection mechanism. Do a solid job in the construction of the "head-to-head" diversified dispute resolution mechanism for disputes involving overseas Chinese between the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and enhance the quality and efficiency of diversified resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese. Actively cooperate with relevant departments to promote the establishment of diversified professional mediation organizations for matters involving overseas Chinese in accordance with the law, vigorously cultivate commercial mediation organizations, and promote the formation of a grand mediation work pattern for disputes involving overseas Chinese that is based on people's mediation, with various types of mediation complementing each other, organically connecting, and working in coordination.

7. Actively Support the Development of Mediation Organizations for Matters Involving Overseas Chinese. People's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the law, strengthen business guidance for mediation organizations for matters involving overseas Chinese, actively invite mediators for matters involving overseas Chinese to observe court hearings, participate in conflict and dispute resolution, organize joint training for judges, mediators, and overseas Chinese affairs cadres, assist mediation organizations for matters involving overseas Chinese in improving their mediation capabilities, and vigorously cultivate composite talents for resolving disputes involving overseas Chinese. Make good use of the special invited mediator roster system, widely absorb overseas Chinese deputies to people's congresses, members of political consultative conferences, leaders of overseas Chinese communities, representatives of overseas Chinese compatriots, etc., as mediators, actively support qualified mediation organizations and mediators for matters involving overseas Chinese to join the roster, comprehensively use such roster management measures as data statistics, performance evaluation, judicial confirmation feedback, and handling of violations, and guide the healthy and orderly development of mediation organizations and mediators for matters involving overseas Chinese. Give full play to the role of mediation organizations for matters involving overseas Chinese, and guide parties in cases involving overseas Chinese to express their claims rationally and protect their legitimate rights and interests in accordance with the law. Where an agreement is reached through mediation by a mediation organization for matters involving overseas Chinese established in accordance with the law, and the parties apply for judicial confirmation, the people's court shall confirm the validity of the mediation agreement in accordance with the law.

8. Strengthen Funding Guarantees. The Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, together with relevant departments, shall, in accordance with policies and based on actual circumstances, coordinate the implementation of funds for guiding mediation work, subsidies for mediation organizations, and allowances for mediators. People's courts at all levels shall, together with federations of returned overseas Chinese, actively promote the inclusion of domestic mediation legal services in the guiding catalog of government-purchased services, and continuously enhance the funding guarantee for mediation work related to overseas Chinese. Support and guide qualified mediation organizations for matters involving overseas Chinese to operate in a market-based manner. Encourage returned overseas Chinese, their family members, overseas Chinese compatriots, and enterprises to provide social donations and public welfare funding to provide necessary financial support for the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests.

9. Strengthen Communication and Coordination. People's courts at all levels and federations of returned overseas Chinese at the same level shall maintain close working ties, strengthen coordination and information sharing, and promptly hold consultations and studies on universal, trending, and nascent issues in conflicts and disputes involving overseas Chinese. Support mediation organizations, arbitration institutions, notarization institutions, law firms, etc., for matters involving overseas Chinese in establishing and improving work connection mechanisms, and give full play to the role of non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms. Steadily promote cooperation with extraterritorial diversified dispute resolution institutions in business exchanges, personnel training, etc.

10. Strengthen Research on the Judicial Protection of Overseas Chinese Rights and Interests. Support the role of research platforms such as the China Research Base for the Judicial Protection of Overseas Chinese Rights and Interests, organize exchange activities focusing on legislation related to overseas Chinese, theories on judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, cutting-edge issues in judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, and typical case analysis of matters involving overseas Chinese, close the connection between theory and practice, provide theoretical support for strengthening the practice of judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, and provide practical material for deepening theoretical research on the protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests.

11. Strengthen Publicity and Guidance. People's courts shall strengthen legal reasoning in judgment documents, further build and make good use of the people's court case database, explain the law through cases, give play to the regulatory, evaluative, educational, and guiding functions of judicial judgments, strengthen judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, and promote the resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese at the source. People's courts and federations of returned overseas Chinese at all levels shall actively publicize the advantages of non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms and the effectiveness of judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, organically integrate the spirit of overseas Chinese loving their country, hometown, and family with traditional Chinese dispute resolution concepts, and guide the vast number of overseas Chinese compatriots, returned overseas Chinese, and their family members to protect their rights and resolve disputes independently in accordance with the law. On the basis of summarizing practical achievements, publicize and commend, by appropriate means, a group of mediators for matters involving overseas Chinese who have a strong political stance, high professional competence, and good public response.

12. Strengthen Organizational Leadership. For problems encountered in the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, the system of requesting instructions and reporting on major matters shall be strictly implemented, and instructions and reports shall be actively made to Party committees to seek support. High people's courts and federations of returned overseas Chinese of all provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government) shall strengthen the organization, supervision, and guidance of work on judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests, respect the pioneering spirit at the grassroots level, encourage grassroots units to actively explore new mechanisms and new measures for the judicial protection of overseas Chinese rights and interests; promptly sum up work experience, study new situations, solve new problems, and report important progress, major issues, important suggestions, and typical cases level by level to the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese.

December 27, 2024
